new_slugs.name: Khairpur State
new_slugs.why: state Cliopatria lacks; direct successor of talpur-dynasty (Khairpur princely state, 1843-1955)

gaps.what: Districts and year of the stripping of Ali Murad's upper-Sindh lands by the East India Company. The Khairpur (town) page gives only the accusation, 1851-2, and 'stripped of his lands in upper Sindh'; the Khairpur princely state, Khairpur District and Mir Ali Murad Khan Talpur pages are silent. Leads, unconfirmed: Sabzalkot and Bhung (bahawalpur-state /ledger/1, 1847-48; Mir Sohrab Khan Talpur page); try the Sabzalkot, Ghotki District or Kashmore pages.
Extent of the state in 1843-1852, larger than the 70 km disc by an unknown amount (the Khairpur town page: afterwards 'mostly Khairpur city, and its immediate environs')

Start at 1832 (Mir Ali Murad Khan Talpur page: treaty of 4 April 1832 'recognised the political individuality of Khairpur') instead of 1843; needs a coordinated edit that cuts Khairpur out of the talpur-dynasty shape
gaps.why: out of scope: touches talpur-dynasty, whose verdict was thin and which this repair does not edit

problems: khairpur-state repaired: it now ends 1955-9 (Khairpur page: 'Disestablished: 30 September 1955', 'fully amalgamated into West Pakistan in 1955') with a single dissolve into islamic-republic-of-pakistan at confidence 3; the 1947-10 loss was deleted; keyframe, capital, certainty and last ruler (George Ali Murad to 1954) extended. Validates with 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Finding 2 (Ali Murad's loss of upper-Sindh lands) not applied: the Khairpur (town) page dates the accusation (1851-2) and says he was stripped of his lands in upper Sindh, but no page opened names districts or an area, so a loss event would carry no region; recorded as a gap and in notes.

The reviewer's text says islamic-republic-of-pakistan records vassal_start khairpur-state 1947-10 / vassal_end 1955-9. It does not: the Pakistan ledger has no Khairpur event (its notes list Khairpur among states without a dossier). The owner of islamic-republic-of-pakistan should add vassal_start 1947-10, vassal_end 1955-9 and a gain 1955-9 with khairpur-state.

Model conflict still open for the princely states of Pakistan: islamic-republic-of-pakistan gains bahawalpur-state (1947-10) and khanate-of-kalat (1948-3) at accession while both of those dossiers run to 14 October 1955; khairpur-state now follows them (vassal 1947-1955, merge 1955). The Khairpur page dates the end 30 September 1955 and does not mention One Unit (14 October 1955).

british-empire and british-raj have no vassal_start/vassal_end for khairpur-state (British suzerainty 1843-1947; british-raj has only the blanket princely-states entry) and both draw the whole Sind province, Khairpur included, from 1843.
